nodes.description: Array of Pool structs holding per-pool AMM state (trade volumes, cached fee, last sqrt K, CerUsd credit).
Mapping token address to cached vault address and pool id.
Global Settings struct: mint fee beneficiary, mint fee multiplier, fee and TVL multiplier bounds.
Wrapped native token address selected by chain id in the constructor.
Owner slot of the Ownable contract; gates all admin functions.

ERC1155 per-id total supply used in LP amount math.
ERC1155 operator approval mapping account => operator => approved.
External payable pool creator; guarded by bot detection/cron modifier.
Internal pool creation: clones vault, pulls tokens, mints CerUsd, mints LP tokens.
External add-liquidity entry point with bot, pool existence and expiry modifiers.

External remove-liquidity entry point with bot, pool existence and expiry modifiers.
Internal liquidity removal: burns LP, burns CerUsd, pays out tokens to _transferTo.
External exact-in swap entry point.

External exact-out swap entry point.

Low-level native value transfer to an arbitrary address.

Constant-product output amount formula with fee.
Constant-product input amount formula with fee.
Dynamic fee computed from rolling trade volume versus TVL bounds and admin settings.

Owner-only overwrite of a pool's CerUsd credit.
Ownable ownership transfer restricted to the current owner.
ERC1155 approval setter wrapped in the bot-detection/cron modifier.
ERC1155 transfer entry point with approval and bot modifiers.

Internal ERC1155 mint with unchecked balance update and receiver callback.
Internal ERC1155 burn with unchecked supply decrement.
Try/catch external callback to the ERC1155 receiver of the destination.
Modifier performing bot detection, transaction registration and cron job execution around the body.
Modifier performing bot-address check and cron job execution after the body.
Computes protocol-owned LP minted as a fee on liquidity events.
Babylonian square root helper used for K value math.
Sets the initial owner, per-chain native token and the first empty pool.
Empty payable receive function accepting native token deposits.
Reads the token and CerUsd balances of a pool vault.
Derives the current trade-volume period from block.timestamp.
Wraps _getOutput with the dynamically computed fee for a token-to-CerUsd conversion.
Wraps _getInput with the dynamically computed fee for a token-to-CerUsd conversion.
Reads a vault's native or ERC20 balance depending on the token.
Computes the deterministic create2 vault address off-chain style via inline assembly.
Returns the contract owner.
Returns the cached vault address, deriving and caching it when unset.
Resolves a utility contract address from the Cerby token registry.
Checks code size via inline assembly extcodesize.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, transfers, approvals and refunds.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for expiry checks and trade period selection.
Low-level call to an attacker-supplied token address in _safeCoreTransferFrom.
Low-level value call to an arbitrary _to address in _safeCoreTransferNative.
Inline assembly create2 deployment of the vault minimal proxy in cloneVault.
Inline assembly memory layout and keccak256 used to derive the future vault address.
Inline assembly extcodesize contract check in isContract.

CerUsd-to-token input computation using the fee-free _getInput path.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the source address into the bot-detection modifier and later used as token payer.
_createPool pulls tokens from msg.sender into the freshly cloned vault.
addTokenLiquidity uses msg.sender for the bot check and as the liquidity payer.
_addTokenLiquidity transfers tokens from msg.sender.
removeTokenLiquidity uses msg.sender for the bot check and as the LP holder.
_removeTokenLiquidity burns LP tokens belonging to msg.sender.
swapExactTokensForTokens uses msg.sender as swapper and bot-check subject.
_swapExactTokensForTokens pulls the input tokens from msg.sender.
swapTokensForExactTokens uses msg.sender as swapper and bot-check subject.
_swapTokensForExactTokens pulls the input tokens from msg.sender.
_swap emits the Swap event with msg.sender and applies msg.sender-originated amounts.
The _from == msg.sender branch decides whether tokens are pulled or native value is forwarded.
Excess native value is refunded to msg.sender.
increaseCerUsdCreditInPool burns CerUsd from msg.sender.
setApprovalForAll grants approval on behalf of msg.sender.
safeTransferFrom checks msg.sender through the bot and approval modifiers.
operator local is assigned from msg.sender in _safeTransferFrom.
operator local is assigned from msg.sender in _mint.
operator local is assigned from msg.sender in _burn.
The constructor assigns ownership to msg.sender.
msg.sender becomes contractOwner, granting full admin power.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against contractOwner before transferring ownership.
onlyOwner restricts settings mutation to the owner address.
onlyOwner restricts privileged pool creation to the owner address.
onlyOwner restricts direct CerUsd credit overwrite to the owner address.
block.timestamp determines the current trade volume period, making fee logic timestamp dependent.
The dynamic fee depends on the timestamp-derived period and rolling volumes.
transactionIsNotExpired compares block.timestamp with the caller deadline.
transactionIsNotExpired compares block.timestamp with the caller deadline.
transactionIsNotExpired compares block.timestamp with the caller deadline.
transactionIsNotExpired compares block.timestamp with the caller deadline.
Miner-controlled timestamp selects the period whose trade volume counter is updated.
createPool delegates all work to _createPool.
_createPool deploys the vault clone via cloneVault.
_createPool deposits the caller tokens into the new vault.
_createPool reads the actually deposited balance with _getTokenBalance.
_createPool computes the initial sqrt K value.
_createPool mints MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY to DEAD and the remaining LP to _transferTo.
_createPool pushes the new Pool struct into the pools array.
_createPool caches the new pool id for the token.
adminCreatePool calls _createPool with maximum CerUsd credit.
addTokenLiquidity delegates to _addTokenLiquidity.
The bot detection/cron modifier wraps the external add-liquidity call.
_addTokenLiquidity transfers the caller tokens into the vault.
_addTokenLiquidity re-reads the vault token balance after the transfer.
_addTokenLiquidity computes the protocol mint-fee LP amount.
_addTokenLiquidity recomputes sqrt K.
_addTokenLiquidity mints fee LP and user LP.
_addTokenLiquidity updates the stored pool sqrt K value.
LP minting math reads erc1155TotalSupply.
removeTokenLiquidity delegates to _removeTokenLiquidity.
The bot detection/cron modifier wraps the external remove-liquidity call.
_removeTokenLiquidity charges the protocol mint fee in LP.
_removeTokenLiquidity mints the protocol fee LP.
_removeTokenLiquidity burns the caller LP tokens.
_removeTokenLiquidity pays the underlying tokens out of the vault.
_removeTokenLiquidity snapshots pool balances before computing payouts.
Payout math divides by erc1155TotalSupply.
swapExactTokensForTokens delegates to _swapExactTokensForTokens.
The bot detection/cron modifier wraps the swap call.
_swapExactTokensForTokens reads pool balances before quoting.
Token-in quotes use _getOutputExactTokensForCerUsd.
CerUsd-to-token quotes use _getOutputExactCerUsdForTokens.
_swapExactTokensForTokens pulls the input tokens from the caller.
_swapExactTokensForTokens settles the swap through _swap.
swapTokensForExactTokens delegates to _swapTokensForExactTokens.
The bot detection/cron modifier wraps the swap call.
_swapTokensForExactTokens reads pool balances before quoting.
Exact-output quotes use _getInputTokensForExactCerUsd.
CerUsd-to-token exact-output quotes use _getInputCerUsdForExactTokens.
_swapTokensForExactTokens pulls the computed input amount.
_swapTokensForExactTokens settles through _swap.
_swap re-reads pool balances to derive the actual amounts in.
_swap obtains the current trade period.
_swap refreshes the cached fee from trade volumes.
_swap pays the CerUsd and token outputs out of the vault.
_swap writes creditCerUsd, trade volume and cached fee back into the Pool struct.
_swap resolves the pool through cachedTokenValues.
Credit, sqrt K and trade volume values are narrow-cast to uint128/uint40, allowing silent truncation.
_getCurrentFeeBasedOnTrades skips the current timestamp-derived period.
Fee bounds and TVL multipliers come from the settings state variable.
The dynamic fee is fetched before applying _getOutput.
_getOutputExactTokensForCerUsd applies the constant-product output formula.
The dynamic fee is fetched before applying _getInput.
_getInputTokensForExactCerUsd applies the constant-product input formula.
The mint fee percentage is read from settings.
The returned LP fee multiplies total supply by the fee delta; extreme pool sizes can overflow or truncate.
The token branch performs the ERC20 transferFrom through _safeCoreTransferFrom.
The native branch performs the value transfer through _safeCoreTransferNative.
_safeTransferFromHelper resolves the vault address for withdrawal.
The helper branches on whether the token equals NATIVE_TOKEN.
Withdrawals from a user-supplied vault address are external calls.
_safeCoreTransferFrom performs a low-level call on the token address.
_safeCoreTransferNative performs a low-level value call to _to.
cloneVault uses inline assembly create2 to deploy the minimal proxy.
An uncached vault address is derived by _generateVaultAddressByToken.
The predicted address is computed with inline assembly and keccak256.
_safeTransferFrom updates balances inside an unchecked subtraction block.
_mint updates balances inside an unchecked addition block.
_burn decrements total supply inside an unchecked block.
_safeTransferFrom writes erc1155Balances.
_mint writes erc1155Balances.
_mint increases erc1155TotalSupply.
_burn writes erc1155Balances.
_burn decreases erc1155TotalSupply.
_safeTransferFrom runs the receiver acceptance check after updating balances.
_mint runs the receiver acceptance check after updating balances.
The acceptance check performs an external onERC1155Received call.
The acceptance check only runs when the destination is a contract.
isContract uses inline assembly extcodesize.
safeTransferFrom performs the actual ERC1155 transfer.
setApprovalForAll writes erc1155OperatorApprovals.
increaseCerUsdCreditInPool increments the pool credit field.
The pool is resolved through cachedTokenValues.
adminUpdateSettings overwrites the global settings struct.
adminChangeCerUsdCreditInPool overwrites the pool credit value.
transferOwnership reassigns the contractOwner slot.
The modifier calls the bot detection contract before and executeCronJobs after the body.
The modifier checks the bot address and executes cron jobs externally.
_getPoolBalances reads the vault balances with _getTokenBalance.
_getPoolBalances uses the cached vault address when available.
_getTokenBalance returns the native balance when the token is NATIVE_TOKEN.
The constructor sets NATIVE_TOKEN based on the chain id.
A malicious ERC1155 receiver can reenter the token contract during the acceptance callback.
LP minting during a swap triggers an external receiver callback that can reenter the swap flow.
Withdrawing from a user-supplied vault address makes an external call that can reenter the swap bookkeeping.
The bot detection and cron job contracts are external and are invoked around the swap body, enabling reentrancy.
executeCronJobs runs inside the swap transaction and can reenter pool state mutations.

LP tokens may be minted to an arbitrary caller-chosen address.
The caller deadline participates in the timestamp expiry check.

The transfer destination is caller controlled.

The transferred amount feeds the unchecked balance subtraction.

The output token is caller controlled and used for vault lookups.
The minimum output bound is caller controlled.
The maximum input bound is caller controlled.
The new owner address is caller controlled but gated by onlyOwner.
The supplied settings struct is written after owner and sanity checks.
The operator address for approval is caller controlled.
The approval flag is caller controlled.
The freshly cloned vault receives the pool deposits.
The pre-swap balances snapshot is the baseline for the K invariant check.
The observed CerUsd inflow drives credit and trade volume updates.
Swap outputs are withdrawn from this resolved vault address.
The cached operator is emitted in the ERC1155 transfer event.
This balance is used in the unchecked subtraction that can silently underflow.
The timestamp-derived period indexes the trade volume array in _swap.
The create2 salt derived from the token determines the vault address.
The resolved pool id indexes pools and erc1155TotalSupply.
The computed CerUsd payout amount is burned from the vault.
